approvals.statement: This NDA provides for the use of Lyrfigtu (lirafugratinib) capsule for the treatment of adults with previously treated, unresectable, locally advanced or metastatic cholangiocarcinoma harboring a fibroblast growth factor receptor 2 (FGFR2) fusion or other rearrangement.
